bio: This alternative to the fine dining restaurant at Hotel Trofana Royal also serves culinary delights right next to the ski slope. In an inviting decor, diners can choose from an appealing à la carte selection of freshly prepared Tyrolean dishes. These are made with the finest regional produce, such as Paznaun Highland beef, Diasbach trout and traditional Alpine cheese. Open to the lobby and bar area, and with only a handful of tables, this restaurant is done out in lots of warm wood, creating a pleasantly cosy feel. Exceptionally courteous and friendly service....
